LanguageData.SSC_CosmeticRitualPattern.descOverride:
The scent of fluid and herbs mingles with prayer as the faithful await a gift of beauty. A lovelier face may follow; the burning pain always does.
Success improves Beauty by one step, up to Beautiful. Requires 20 regular PNA, 2 herbal medicine and a practitioner with Medical 6 or higher. At Medical 6, baseline success is about 61.5%. Medical skill, surroundings and spectators affect the result.
